record_title: Precompact rigidity and horoball limit sets for metric-functional weak convergence
limitations: The universal-limit construction is proved for the regular binary R-tree, not arbitrary proper CAT(0) spaces. Bounded subsets of non-proper spaces need not be totally bounded. The result concerns the metric-functional d-weak topology, not the projection/Delta-weak topology on CAT(0) spaces. The motivating topology paper is very recent, so unindexed parallel work remains possible.
